description: Defines the internal class NatsStreamConsumer in the Orleans.Streaming.NATS namespace, which acts as a wrapper around a NATS JetStream consumer, providing methods to initialize the consumer and fetch messages asynchronously.

classes.name: NatsStreamConsumer
classes.description: A wrapper class for managing a NATS JetStream consumer, enabling message fetching and consumer initialization.

methods.name: GetMessages
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches messages from the NATS JetStream consumer, deserializing them and returning the message array along with the count.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the consumer by creating or updating it in the NATS context.
